name: tests-merged
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun test core/count-ranges.test.ts core/count-cubes.test.ts core/counts-preflight.test.ts core/count-admission.test.ts core/count-witness.test.ts core/count-focused.test.ts core/count-cases.test.ts core/runtime-keys.test.ts core/compile.test.ts core/exists.test.ts core/quorum-laws.test.ts research/track-gen/t14-stutter.test.ts core/finite-tiny.test.ts core/finite-tiny-houdini.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -25

name: check-merged
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check 2>&1 | grep -v 'vendor/handwired' | grep -v 'research/\(enum\|gpu\|next\|search\|synth\|table\)/' | tail -20; st=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo CHECK_EXIT $st; exit $st
